:::::::: {.tsk-section}
## What this site is for

Therapy Skill Kit is an educational toolkit. It is designed to help people learn and practice common skills associated with CBT, DBT, mindfulness, behavior change, and general wellness.

It is not a diagnosis tool, crisis service, or substitute for individualized medical or mental-health care. The Skills Finder recommends learning material, not treatment.
